AD CRAFT: one focal subject, sharp and well lit with natural commercial light; a clean background with breathing room; the brand colors living in the wardrobe, props or background accents; nothing decorative the brief did not ask for. Give the copy a calm, high-contrast area so it reads at a glance.
SAFE MARGIN: keep all text, logos, CTA and key subjects at least 8% away from every edge; only background may reach the edge, nothing else may touch or cross the frame.
BRIEF FIDELITY: keep every concrete element of the brief (product, packaging, people, setting, action); a composition reference only guides placement and never replaces the requested subject.
VISIBLE TEXT: only the literal copy below and the official logo; no subheadlines, lists, statistics, badges, dates or small print the brief did not write.
NEUTRAL ASSET MODE: This request is a page, background, texture, scene or other reusable visual asset, not a branded advertisement. Do not apply, infer, reserve space for, or describe the project's logo, palette, font system, product, claim or campaign. Follow only the user's requested visual material and any selected reference contract.
DO NOT ADD: icons, badges, seals, stickers, extra buttons, charts, captions or decorative words that the briefing did not ask for. Phone, laptop and app screens show only abstract interface shapes: no readable words, numbers, prices, dates or charts on any screen.

REFERENCE CONTRACT:
IMAGE 1: source=user; the primary/base image whose unrequested content must be preserved (Captura interna — UOL).
Respect the declared role of every image. Never silently swap the base image and a supporting reference. Apart from the supplied official brand logo, never add third-party logos, prices or offers that the user did not request.
NEUTRAL ASSET CHECK: Do not reserve space for a logo, headline, price, product packshot or brand lockup unless the user explicitly asks for that element.
FORMAT: 1024x1536px (2:3); this format overrides any size written in the brief.
